# S-030 · Gebruik van AI-technologie door Nederlandse microbedrijven

## What it says

- Among Dutch micro firms that considered AI and decided against it, lack of experience was the main reason (71.6%) [W4-023].
- About half named privacy [W4-024].
- Micro firms are smaller than the reader's firm [W4-023].
